messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: prod /chat/completions p99 > 1.2s in us-east-1 (triggered at 1951112222). Pager: page oncall.

mira: seeing it too. p95 looks fine (~220ms) but p99 spikes to ~1.4s for several routes.

sanjay: preliminary triage: bursts concentrated on routes that hit model:mistral-7b and model:mix-13b-quant. KV cache hit rate dropped ~30% in the window.

mira: probable root cause could be cold KV partitions + a small hardware blip in the pool. Not seeing error rates rise though — requests still succeeding, just slower tail.

jen-oncall: i'm on pager, grabbing logs + traces. will check autoscaler and node metrics.

leo: adding relevant dashboard snapshot: /dashboards/latency/chat-completions?range=15m (posted). p99 curve correlates with spikes in request concurrency on a subset of hosts.

jen-oncall: confirmed one host (gpu-node-54) had elevated steal and IO wait around the start of the spike. Kernel schedules look noisy.

mira: for immediate mitigation we should: 1) route traffic away from the noisy hosts (evict), 2) enable per-route noise gate so we don't page on short-lived p99 blips, 3) fallback to smaller model if p99 stays high for >10m. thoughts?

sanjay: agree. propose a short-term alert change: reduce page noise by changing the alert from `for: 1m` to `for: 5m` for p99 on chat routes, and enable a squelch that ignores single-host blips. keep p95 alert intact.

mira: yes — keep p95 hard so we catch regressions, but p99 should have a slightly longer window or be routed to slack-only for non-prod tiers. For prod critical customers we keep paging.

jen-oncall: i'm going to evict pods from gpu-node-54 and cordon it. also flipping the canary routing to bypass model:mistral-7b for high-concurrency routes.

ops-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: #1234 cordon/evict gpu-node-54 (jen-oncall), #1235 temporary alert-window-change (sanjay), #1236 route-fallback-policy (mira).

leo: for the alert change, suggest we add an explicit per-model label so we can set thresholds by model family. Example: `alert when p99 > 1.2s and model in (mistral-7b, mix-13b-quant) for 5m` otherwise slack-only.

mira: good call. we should also create a dashboard tile that splits p99 by model and route so oncall can quickly see which variant is responsible. request to dashboard-bot to create that.

dashboard-bot: created ticket DASH-457: "p99 by model + route — chat/completions". ETA 2h (will add heatmap and host-mapping).

sanjay: sketch for alert rule i'll apply (temp):
```yaml
- alert: ChatCompletions_P99_Prod
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{env="prod",endpoint="/chat/completions"}[5m])) by (le, model, route)) > 1.2
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
    team: platform
  annotations:
    summary: "prod chat/completions p99 > 1.2s ({{ $labels.model }} / {{ $labels.route }})"
```

mira: when we flip this rule we should add an automation that silences paging if the offending hosts are a minority (e.g., >60% of p99 coming from <=2 hosts). simple script can compute host attribution from traces.

jen-oncall: eviction done, node cordoned. routing bypass active. early signals: p99 dropping back to ~850ms for the heavier models, overall p95 unchanged. filters look less noisy.

leo: i'll draft a follow-up playbook item for the runbook: "If p99 spikes but errors=0 and p95 stable -> check host-level skew + kv cache hit rate -> cordon/evict -> if p99 persists >15m then failover to smaller model or increase capacity."

mira: agree. also add a monitoring task: instrument per-route kv-cache hit ratio so we can alert on cache regressions before tail worsens.

ops-bot: NOTE: Customer impact assessment required for any incident that triggers pages >15m. Current page time ~8m and mitigations trending good. No customer-visible errors found in logs.

jen-oncall: handing off to night oncall @jen-oncall (me) for monitoring. i'll leave the temporary alert change in place and watch for recurrences.

sanjay: postmortem action items: 1) permanent per-model p99 thresholds + noise gating rules (owner: sanjay) 2) KV cache metrics + alert (owner: leo) 3) dashboard tile and runbook update (owner: mira) 4) infra root cause for noisy host (owner: infra-team).

mira: i'll own the runbook update and coordinate infra-team. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (non-critical). summary: transient host-level resource contention caused p99 tail increase for chat/completions models; evict/route-fallback restored tails. follow-ups created: #1235, #1236, DASH-457.

jen-oncall: logging handoff: please ping me in morning if automated tests show any regression. overnight watchlist: model:mistral-7b, model:mix-13b-quant, gpu-node-54.

leo: adding a little extra: propose we reduce paging noise long-term by splitting alerts: page for customer-impacting p99 (based on client error rates or SLA requests) and slack-only for internal noise; that way SRE still gets visibility without unnecessary wakeups.

mira: love that — i'll add it to the postmortem scope.

jen-oncall: thanks team, handing off now.
